zh.title: 命令还在跑，也能接收新指令
zh.lead: 前台等待有上限，耗时命令转入后台；新指令在下一推理步骤处理。
zh.diagramLabel: 同步与异步会话的并列事件时间线
zh.caption: 两条路径处理同一事件序列；只对比阻塞关系，不比较虚构的任务完成速度。
zh.send: 发送“先别提交，继续查日志”
zh.dimension: 前台等待上限：5 秒 → 返回后台任务句柄
zh.jobHint: 条带仅表示逻辑阶段，不表示真实耗时或完成百分比。
zh.step0Explanation: 同步循环与异步配置都先启动测试。差异在于工具调用会占住前台多久。
zh.step0Code:
Executor preset: dsh-superagent-worker
Foreground commands move to background after 5 seconds.
zh.step1Explanation: 原型的 shell 和 job-wait 上限均为 5000ms。超过前台等待上限不等于杀掉命令，命令作为后台任务继续运行。
zh.step2Explanation: 异步路径通过 steer 把输入送入 Worker，在下一步骤读取。同步路径仍被命令阻塞，输入继续等待。
zh.step3Title: 完成事件再次唤醒会话
zh.step3Explanation: 后台任务完成后，tool-jobs 向会话投递结果；空闲会话可被唤醒。同步路径此时才有机会处理排队消息。
zh.limit0: 5 秒是公开原型的前台等待配置，不是模型响应或任务完成的时间保证。
zh.limit1: 新输入在推理步骤之间处理；它不会让同一个 Session 任意并行推理，也不能中断任何同步工具。
zh.limit2: 后台任务完成会投递通知，但进程内 jobs 不会因持久化了 Session 就跨进程存活。
zh.raceTitle: 请求停止，不等于已经停止
zh.raceOverlap: 请求取消后，完成先于结算
zh.raceCaption: job_kill 可以返回 cancellation-requested 或 already-finished；需要读取实际状态，而不是把取消请求当作已撤销全部效果。

en.simulation: Teaching simulation · No real agent or API execution
en.codeNote: Source excerpts or implementation summaries omit surrounding details. Demo data is fictional.
en.fallback: Enable JavaScript to explore each step. The static diagram, explanation, and sources work without it.
en.title: Keep talking while a command runs
en.lead: Bound foreground waiting and move long commands to background jobs. Process new instructions at the next inference step.
en.diagramLabel: Side-by-side event timelines for synchronous and asynchronous sessions
en.caption: Both lanes receive the same events. This compares blocking, not invented task-completion speeds.
en.send: Send “Do not commit yet; inspect logs”
en.dimension: Foreground wait cap: 5 s → return a background job handle
en.jobHint: Bars show logical phases, not measured duration or completion percentages.
en.async1: Can take the next inference step
en.step0Explanation: Both sessions start the test. The difference is how long the tool call occupies the foreground.
en.step0Code:
Executor preset: dsh-superagent-worker
Foreground commands move to background after 5 seconds.
en.step1Title: The wait cap releases the foreground
en.step1Explanation: The prototype caps shell and job waits at 5000ms. Reaching the foreground wait cap does not kill the command; it continues as a background job.
en.step2Title: The user sends a new instruction
en.step2Explanation: The async path steers input into the Worker for its next step. The synchronous path remains blocked on the command, so the input waits.
en.step3Explanation: On completion, tool-jobs delivers a result and may wake an idle session. The synchronous path can now process its queued input.
en.limit0: Five seconds is the public prototype foreground wait setting, not a guarantee of model response time or task completion.
en.limit1: Input is processed between inference steps. This does not allow arbitrary parallel inference within one Session or interrupt every synchronous tool.
en.limit2: Background completion delivers a notice, but persisting a Session does not make in-process jobs survive a process restart.
en.raceTitle: Requesting cancellation is not a terminal state
en.raceCaption: job_kill may return cancellation-requested or already-finished. Inspect actual state rather than assuming the request reverses all effects.
